target: acceptance 1 — the minimax alias meets the same bar (minimax-m2's 204,800 fails this)
cmd: resolve() { cat "$FIXTURES/preflight/brief-small.json" | MOCK_RESPONSE_FILE="$FIXTURES/openrouter-ok.json" bash "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/call_openrouter.sh" --model "$1" 2>/dev/null | jq -r ".worker" | sed "s|^openrouter/||"; }; ID=$(resolve minimax); echo "minimax=$ID"; CTX=$(jq -r --arg i "$ID" '.data[] | select(.id==$i) | .context_length' $FIXTURES/alias-liveness/catalog-full.json); echo "context=$CTX"; [ -n "$CTX" ] && [ "$CTX" -ge 1000000 ] && echo MEETS_BAR
